subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror and inter-session transcript rows before merge?
rationale: The patch appears correct and well-proven, but it intentionally changes which A2A transcript rows can feed visible reply delivery, which green CI cannot fully settle for all channel histories.

options.title: Accept the boundary and land
options.body: Treat message-tool mirrors and inter-session bookkeeping rows as non-deliverable waited replies, relying on the supplied Gateway and QA proof plus exact-head CI.

options.title: Require broader live-channel proof
options.body: Ask for a live third-party channel capture before merge if maintainers want channel-specific evidence beyond the QA transport and Gateway regression.

options.title: Pause for broader A2A coordination
options.body: Hold this PR until the adjacent reverse sessions_send and compaction duplicate work is resolved as one delivery-boundary plan.

recommendation.title: Accept the boundary and land
recommendation.body: Treat message-tool mirrors and inter-session bookkeeping rows as non-deliverable waited replies, relying on the supplied Gateway and QA proof plus exact-head CI.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent delivery-mirror provenance work makes this the strongest available owner signal for accepting the waited-reply boundary.
